notes.title: Update and release date info
notes.content:
[h1][b]First off, thank you for wish listing my game![/b][/h1]

It's always been a life goal of mine to put a game onto steam, and I've finally been lucky enough to achieve that dream, so thank you everyone!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568684/cbf47136829056d6339e1d27fe6e891ab1b2fb97.png[/img]

[h1][b]So then. what's the plan for my game?[/b][/h1]

Currently, I'm reworking a lot of the core systems that I made when the game was first started, this has taken a lot of my development time so far, but this rework will allow me to add many more features to the game and help expand upon the current systems that are in place, this was a side project of mine at the start, and I didn't expect any following for the game, but now that I see there's some interest in the project I want to do right by it, and by you guys, so when you press play for the first time, you can get treated with many more features and content that I'm sure you will love

[h2][b]So that's cool and all, but what else are you actually working on?[/b][/h2]

Currently, I'm working on the mana and spell system
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568684/572c3b1c4cc9fd5591734c95de0698c1d8aa76f0.png[/img]

[i]I'm also working on a class system and more types of progression you can unlock, I don't have anyhting to show but I will be back with more information when the time is right[/i]

[h2][b]But that's pretty much it for now[/b][/h2]
I'm still working on the game, fixing core systems, and expanding the features

And thank you for reading! we actually have a discord where you can get pinged when any updates/information about are games get dropped! I would love to see you there, it would actually make my day :D

[h3][b][u]https://discord.gg/dPacMcPKeP[/u][/b][/h3]

[b][h2]Also, there is one last thing I wanted to share with you all, another project of sorts...[/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568684/c3bd4ff451f0329772258689b109284e42f8d6f1.png[/img]
:)
